en:
Hey, hey Shuichi!
I need your help with something.
I'd be happy to help.

Yayyyy! Thank you! Now then, I want you
to help me look for something.

That shouldn't be a problem.
What are you looking for?
A sickle!
...A sickle?

Yeah, a sickle! Y'know, crescent-shaped blade,
wooden handle, cuts stuff easily...

What are you going to do with
that, mow the lawn?

Nyahahaha! No, silly! I'm gonna stab it
into my window!
The window?

On my island, if you feel sad and lonely at
night, you stab a sickle into your window!
That's...an odd custom.

Anyone who sees it can't just ignore it.
They gotta go console that person.

They gotta do anything they can to console
them. And I do mean ANYTHING.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's...frightening.

So whenever I'm feeling sad, I gotta have
a sickle ready.

I see...
Well, if you ever need anything else...

Anything else...?
Hmmm... Nothing else comes to mind.

You're so nice, Shuichi. I bet you'll come
console when I stab my sickle.
Huh? Me?

I wanna be consoled by you!
Nyahahahaha!
Ah, I see...

I'll teach you all of my island's customs,
Shuichi!

First, you're not allowed to feed children
after midnight!

<CLT=cltMIND>...I've heard of a creature
like that somewhere before.

Cuz it's unhealthy! They won't grow up
to be stable adults!
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, alright. That sounds reasonable.

And they hafta undergo a divine initiation
ritual before they can enter adulthood...

<CLT=cltMIND>A ritual? Like a
coming-of-age ceremony?

During the ritual, we perform intense
physical workouts.

They all become adults at the same time,
and feel all happy and relaxed afterward.
...What?

I haven't undergone my ritual yet, but
I hear it's a divine experience.

I...see...
"Happy and relaxed," huh?

That's right. On my island, everyone shares
in our fun, happy times.

At weddings, for example, after the bride
and groom consummate their vows...

The guests make their own vows, and then
they consummate those, too.
<CLT=cltMIND>What, everyone!?

After a successful consummation, the bride
is blessed with a baby.
Of course, we all share the baby, too...
using a sickle...

What...the hell...are you going
to do with that!?

Nyahahahaha! Just kidding!
We can't share a baby!
We just share the bride!
...What does that mean!?

<CLT=cltMIND>This island has a ton of
strange traditions...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>With more questions than answers,
I returned to my room.
